name: engine

metadata.description: Bundles the preview frame scripts (src/frame/*.entry.ts) into src/lib/generated/frames.ts; commit the result. The engine's tests fail while it is stale.
Type-checks the engine on its own; vitest transpiles without checking, so a type error here otherwise surfaces only in publish:bundle or in a project that imports the sources
